A full card image with the corrected text and a white E in the lower border, from the Players Committee's Holotable image set (8 July 2018).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:JP-D-beedo-PC-Errata-2018-E-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Beedo (PC Errata 2018 disc card)]] (24 January 2018): The game text changes: “used pile)” becomes “Used Pile)”. The text box is set again and the white italic “E” in the lower border replaces the bronze disc (349 × 489 pixels).

The whole 2018 disc card image and the whole 2018 E card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
